parameters.name: App
parameters.description: The name of the application to which the live stream belongs.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the custom rule.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the custom rule.

parameters.name: Stream
parameters.description:
The name of the live stream. The following rules apply:

*   A stream name can be exactly matched. Example: liveStreamA.
*   Fuzzy match is also supported. The use of an asterisk (`*`) allows all approximate matches to be found.
*   You can place the asterisk before or after an approximate string.



>*   Fuzzy match: Only one asterisk (`*`) before or after an approximate string is allowed. The approximate string must be enclosed in `()`. Separate multiple strings with vertical bars (`|`).
>*   For example, `*(t1|t2)` matches all streams whose name has the `t1` or `t2` suffix, and `(abc|123)*` matches all streams whose name has the `abc` or `123` prefix.

parameters.name: TemplateId
parameters.description:
The ID of the watermark template.

>  You can obtain the template ID by checking the value of the TemplateId parameter that is returned by the [AddLiveStreamWatermark](~~410759~~) operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live add-live-stream-watermark-rule --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --name WatermarkRule0000 --domain example.aliyundoc.com --app liveApp0000 --stream liveStreamA --template-id 445409ec-7eaa-461d-8f29-4bec2eb90000 --description my_rule --region cn-hangzhou
